class_notes.app-cannot-move-funds: Fixable: gate on version >= 5 / presence of itxn_submit — an app account that can never send has nothing new to strand.
class_notes.assert-false-in-handler: Fixable: handler ends in int 0; assert.
class_notes.asset-optin-zero-amount-self: Fixable: XferAsset of 0 to the app's own address with no close is an opt-in, not an outflow.
class_notes.balance-check-via-acct-params: Fixable: accept acct_params_get AcctBalance/AcctMinBalance as the balance pair.
class_notes.caller-application-pinned: Fixable: global CallerApplicationID == <const> is an authority.
class_notes.close-to-self: Fixable: suppress AssetCloseTo == CurrentApplicationAddress like ZeroAddress.
class_notes.creator-pin-via-gtxn-self-missed: Fixable: GroupSize==1 && GroupIndex==0 makes gtxn 0 Sender == txn Sender.
class_notes.creator-signed-sibling-writer: Fixable: authority._writer only recognises txn Sender guards; gtxn N Sender == CreatorAddress is a creator-signed write.
class_notes.dead-fee-branch: Fixable: constant call arguments select a different switch arm.
class_notes.delete-checks-balance: Fixable: a balance <= K bound before deleting (close-out otherwise) is balance handling; the detector accepts only a direct balance-vs-min_balance comparison (its README still describes an opcode-presence proxy).
class_notes.delete-drains-first: Fixable: accept a CloseRemainderTo/AssetCloseTo inner txn dominating the delete exit as balance handling.
class_notes.exact-division-checked: Fixable: q = a/b followed by assert a == q*b is an exactness check.
class_notes.exit-path-reads-no-absolute-gtxn: Fixable: gate per exit on an absolute gtxn read lying on the entry->exit path, not on the program containing one.
class_notes.exit-value-zero-on-path: Fixable: judge the verdict operand per incoming edge (Delete jumps to int 0; b shared-return).
class_notes.fixed-caller-app-gate: Fixable: global CallerApplicationID == <const> is an authority.
class_notes.fixed-point-scaled-division: Fixable: x*2^64/y before a multiply is fixed-point scaling.
class_notes.foreign-app-admin-gate-missed: Fixable via authority layer: admin read from an app id written only at creation/under creator pin.
class_notes.groupsize-bounded-on-path: Fixable: the backward walk leaves a shared helper through a different call site; needs a return stack (same as UGS _gate_free_exit_through).
class_notes.groupsize-branch-guard-missed: Fixable: root cause not isolated; bnz on GroupSize==K in subroutine-free v2 code.
class_notes.inner-sender-is-caller: Fixable: itxn Sender = txn Sender (rekeyed caller) means the caller pays the fee.
class_notes.key-namespace-prefix-check: Fixable: a key prefix check (extract 0 2 != "i.") in a callee that returns 0 excludes the internal namespace.
class_notes.lifecycle-oc-path: Fixable: close the per-edge walk also on edges that exclude NoOp (predicates_exclude_action(conds, 0)) and on the creation path.
class_notes.no-method-dispatch: Fixable: scope the detector on arg0 being COMPARED to a constant somewhere, not merely read.
class_notes.oc-assert-inside-router-sub: Fixable: OC asserts inside the router subroutine are not seen from the exit after callsub.
class_notes.oc-excluded-on-all-paths: Fixable: same root as retsub-context-merge / router run inside a proto sub.
class_notes.oc-test-combined-in-callee: Fixable: the OC comparison flows through a callee that returns arg && x; carry the predicate through the callee return value tree.
class_notes.payout-backed-by-caller-payment: Fixable: amount asserted equal to the caller's own payment to the app.
class_notes.pin-to-creator-written-local-state: Fixable: receiver pinned to local state whose only writer is creator-gated; the F3 input-vs-input rule fires only because the account index is caller-picked.
class_notes.reach-btoi-dispatch: Fixable: credit a btoi(arg0) dispatch tree ending in ==; assert as a selector pin.
class_notes.receiver-pin-in-returned-boolean: Fixable: the pin is in the same && chain as the read, returned through retsub.
class_notes.receiver-pinned-to-managed-app-address: Fixable via authority layer: creation-only writers preserve authority.
class_notes.retsub-context-merge: Fixable: context-insensitive retsub in the lifecycle walk; needs a return stack.
class_notes.router-verdict-via-retsub: Fixable: judge the exit by verdict_operand; a const-0 phi arm is not approving.
class_notes.same-slot-reread-not-credited: Fixable: a fresh txnas of the same (param) slot should share the check.
class_notes.scratch-store-from-other-path: Fixable: the reaching store of the scratch slot is a constant on this path.
class_notes.select-between-trusted-arms: Fixable: taint from select's CONDITION must not taint the value when both data arms are trusted.
class_notes.selector-checked-in-callee: Fixable: callee err/return-0 fallthrough rejects unmatched selectors.
class_notes.selector-pin-in-conjunction: Fixable: decompose && chains when looking for the selector pin.
class_notes.selector-pin-in-disjunction: Fixable: an || of selector pins is a pin on every arm.
class_notes.sender-pinned-to-trusted-app-address: Fixable via authority layer: app_params_get AppAddress of a preserved app id.
class_notes.sibling-is-outflow-from-escrow: Fixable: skip a pair whose Sender is pinned to the app / a stored escrow — it is an outflow, not a credit.
class_notes.target-pinned-to-creation-state: Fixable: the caller's pin on gtxnsa Applications N is lost when the callee re-reads the slot.
class_notes.zero-amount-sibling-not-credit: Fixable: AssetAmount == 0 / Sender == Receiver siblings credit nothing.

label_semantics.abi-method-selector: TP = an approving exit reachable with arbitrary ApplicationArgs[0] (no selector match and not a bare NumAppArgs==0 route) that performs an action; FP = the exit is only reached after a selector match or a bare-route NumAppArgs==0 test, or is a create/opt-in/close-out OC path not meant to be method-dispatched; INTENDED = a deliberate catch-all/fallback handler.
label_semantics.arbitrary-inner-appcall: TP = attacker chooses the called ApplicationID with app authority and no allowlist; FP = the id is checked; INTENDED = router/proxy design where the callee cannot abuse the app's authority.
label_semantics.arbitrary-inner-asset: As tainted-fund-flow, for XferAsset: TP = attacker names an asset the app holds and it leaves the app with no check; INTENDED = the caller withdraws their own deposit of the asset they name, checked by per-user accounting; FP = the asset id is checked.
label_semantics.constant-condition: TP = a branch condition that is really constant (dead code / always-taken check); FP = the condition is not constant.
label_semantics.delete-funds-check: TP = Delete reachable by anyone with no balance handling; INTENDED = Delete gated to the creator/admin (the admin owns the stranding risk); FP = Delete cannot reach the exit, or the delete path drains the account (close-out inner txn) or the app never holds funds by construction.
label_semantics.group-size-check: TP = an exit whose path relies on an absolute gtxn sibling with no GroupSize bound and no own-GroupIndex pin, so one sibling can be reused by several calls / padding changes the meaning; FP = the path to this exit reads no absolute gtxn, or GroupSize is in fact bounded, or the app pins its own GroupIndex such that padding cannot alter what was checked; UNKNOWN when the sibling's role cannot be judged.
label_semantics.hardcoded-min-balance: TP = a hardcoded min-balance constant that is wrong for the asset/box usage; INTENDED = documented constant matching protocol MBR; FP = not a min-balance constant.
label_semantics.inner-txn-close-rekey: TP = the close/rekey target is attacker-chosen (or the caller) on a path anyone can trigger and it drains a SHARED balance; INTENDED = target is the creator / a fixed address / a preserved admin key, or a per-user escrow closing to its owner; FP = the write is a provable no-op or cannot execute (e.g. closes to the app itself).
label_semantics.inner-txn-fee: TP = a non-zero constant (or MinTxnFee) inner fee on a path any caller can trigger repeatedly without paying the app back; INTENDED = admin-only path, or the caller provably pays the app (sibling payment covering the fee); FP = the fee write is dead/overwritten.
label_semantics.is-updatable: TP = an approving exit really reachable with OnCompletion=UpdateApplication and no sender gate; INTENDED = reachable but gated to the creator/a preserved admin; FP = Update cannot reach the exit with approval (OC excluded on every path, or the path always fails).
label_semantics.partial-tainted-fund-flow: As tainted-fund-flow, for fund fields built from attacker-controlled byte slices.
label_semantics.tainted-asset-admin: TP = attacker-chosen manager/reserve/freeze/clawback address in asset config; FP = checked; INTENDED = asset created for the caller (caller is the beneficiary).
label_semantics.tainted-freeze: TP = attacker-chosen freeze target/asset with app authority; FP = checked; INTENDED = by design.
label_semantics.tainted-fund-flow: TP = an attacker-chosen value reaches the inner-txn fund field (receiver/amount/asset/close) with no effective check in the attacker's disfavour; FP = a real check (sender pin, bound, equality to trusted state, the caller is the beneficiary of their own funds) neutralises it; INTENDED = the attacker-chosen value is the caller's OWN funds/receiver by design (withdraw your own balance to an address you name).
label_semantics.tainted-log: TP = an attacker-chosen value logged where downstream consumers would trust it (ARC-28 event / return value claiming verification); INTENDED = logging the caller's own input (echo/ABI return of input) by design; FP = value is checked.
label_semantics.tainted-state-write: TP = an attacker-chosen key/value written to state with no check that matters for the app's invariants; FP = a check (sender pin, constant set, bound) neutralises it; INTENDED = per-user state the caller is meant to set.
label_semantics.timelock-upgrade: TP = an UNGATED Update path with no delay; INTENDED = admin/creator-gated Update without a delay (the author chose an instantly upgradable admin app); FP = Update cannot reach the exit, or a delay (round/timestamp comparison) gates it.
label_semantics.unprotected-updatable: TP = Update reaches the exit with no effective sender authority check; FP = Update cannot reach it, or a real authority check (creator, preserved admin key, admin-signed sibling, fixed address) gates it; INTENDED = deliberately open upgrade (e.g. governance/immutable-by-other-means) evident from the code.
label_semantics.unsafe-division-order: TP = integer division before multiplication loses precision in a value that matters (amounts/prices); FP = the division is exact by construction or the result does not feed a value; INTENDED = deliberate rounding (e.g. floor fee computation).
label_semantics.unvalidated-group-sibling: TP = the app credits a sibling amount whose receiver is not pinned to an address the app controls (attacker can pay someone else/themselves); FP = the receiver is in fact pinned (by an equivalent check the detector missed) or the read amount is not used as a credit; INTENDED = benign by design (e.g. auction refund flows) where the rule holds but no loss follows.
